title: MilieuxVie: An Open-Source Web Mapping Tool for Complete-Neighbourhood Accessibility in Rural and Peri-Urban Municipalities (Laurentides, Quebec)
description: MilieuxVie is a single-file, browser-based interactive mapping application that assesses context-relative service- and mobility-proximity (the 'complete-neighbourhood' concept) across the 93 territorial units and urban perimeters of the Laurentides health region (RSS 15), Quebec. It evaluates 12 service categories from OpenStreetMap against adaptive distance tiers (dense / intermediate / rural), using residential parcels from the provincial assessment roll as dwelling-weighted origins. This record archives the tool together with its replication data, documentation, and the verbatim regional Overpass query. Accompanies the article in Geographies (MDPI), manuscript geographies-4364677.
